items.stem: Which item is a record rather than a controlled document?

options.text: A completed inspection log showing results for a batch
options.rationale: Correct: a record is evidence of an activity performed; the completed log qualifies.

options.text: A work instruction describing how to inspect
options.rationale: A work instruction is a controlled document, not a record.
The policy is a controlled document.
A blank template is a controlled document until it is filled in.

items.explanation: Correct: a record is evidence of an activity performed; the completed log qualifies.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: A well-written nonconformity statement should contain which TWO elements? (Select TWO.)

options.text: The specific requirement or criterion not met
options.rationale: Correct: a nonconformity cites the requirement it breaches.
Correct: objective evidence supports the finding.

options.text: The auditor's personal opinion of the staff
options.rationale: Opinions about people are not valid audit evidence.

options.text: A guess at who is to blame
options.rationale: Blame is not part of an objective nonconformity.

items.explanation: Correct: a nonconformity cites the requirement it breaches.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: During an audit, which approach best gathers objective evidence?

options.text: Ask open questions and verify answers against records and observation
options.rationale: Correct: triangulating interview, records and observation yields objective evidence.

options.text: Accept the process owner's verbal assurance alone
options.rationale: Unverified assurance is not objective evidence.

options.text: Audit only the documents, never the activity
options.rationale: Documents alone do not confirm the process is followed.

options.text: Rely on what the previous audit concluded
options.rationale: A new audit needs its own current evidence.

items.explanation: Correct: triangulating interview, records and observation yields objective evidence.
